summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A., a Colombian issuer, reporting the payment of dividends scheduled for July 2026 as previously approved by shareholders on March 27, 2026. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, strategic review, or any other special situation is referenced. The document is a routine dividend distribution announcement. Under SEC rules, a Form 6-K for foreign private issuers is used for material information; here it covers a routine corporate action. No deal terms or special-situations dynamics are present, and there is nothing to watch from an event-driven perspective.
